propositions: Shell script normalize_ci_conclusion.sh must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point that implements the same f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> {success, failure, cancelled} contract.

Existing subprocess contract test in tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed to invoke the Python entry point instead of the shell script while preserving its full case table.

Direct unit tests must cover the function's full contract including pass-through rows (success, failure, cancelled), skipped fallback logic (false->success, true->failure), and fail-closed anomalies (empty/unrecognized CONCLUSION).
gerrit-verify.yaml workflow must update sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new .py file and swap the run invocation to call the Python entry point.
The Python entry point must have no external dependencies beyond the standard library so that a single-file sparse-checkout can execute it without package installation.
